name: coil_a
prompt: Cinematic realistic dark ink-wash painting, wide 2.39:1 framing (keep his face and the whole blade inside the middle 70% of the frame height). Reference 1 is the character sheet of swordsman 'Gui Tu': high ponytail, center-parted messy bangs, amber eyes, pale lean face, black cross-collar robe, dark red inner collar, leather bracers. Reference 2 is the previous version of this shot (broken — the blade is detached from the hilt; fix it). New image, ONE single coherent shot: medium close-up, he coils back to gather power before the final slash, body turned three-quarters, both hands gripping the black hilt beside his right cheek, the long single-edged dao drawn back horizontally across the upper frame, the full blade clearly continuous from the guard to the tip, its edge catching a sharp line of golden dawn light that travels along the steel; intense amber eyes looking past the blade toward the enemy; strands of hair and ponytail swept by wind. Dark warm background with soft golden bokeh, ember sparks. Palette strictly black, white, grey, gold, blood red. No text. Correct hands, five fingers each, one complete blade attached to the hilt.

name: coil_b
prompt: 电影级写实暗黑水墨，宽银幕 2.39:1，主体在画面中部 70% 高度内。参考图1 = 男主鬼屠设定（高马尾、中分乱刘海、琥珀眼、苍白清瘦、黑衣暗红内领、皮护腕）。参考图2、3 是上一版的两个镜头（蓄力 MCU 和刀身 ECU，图崩了：刀身和刀柄断开）。请把它们合成一张完整的画：近景，他侧身后撤蓄力，双手紧握黑色刀柄举在右肩旁，长刀刀身水平向画面左侧伸出、横贯画面上半部，刀身完整连续、钢纹清晰、刃口有一条金色晨光，刀柄缠绳和护手细节清楚；他的脸在刀身下方，琥珀色眼睛沿刀身看向前方，眼神凶狠冷静；马尾和碎发被风吹起。背景暗暖色，远处金色光斑虚化，少量火星。只用黑白灰 + 金 + 血红，无任何文字。手部五指正确，刀与刀柄必须连成一体。

name: coil_c
prompt: Cinematic realistic dark ink-wash, wide 2.39:1 frame, subject within middle 70% height. Reference 1: character sheet of swordsman 'Gui Tu' (high ponytail, center-parted messy bangs, amber eyes, pale lean face, black robe, dark red inner collar, leather bracers). Reference 2: old broken version of the shot. Make a new single image: tight medium close-up from slightly low angle, he draws his long dao back over his right shoulder in a coiled stance, blade held level just above eye height, the steel blade running across the frame from his hands on the right to the tip near the left edge, a bright golden glint traveling along the edge; his face in sharp focus between his arms, jaw clenched, amber eyes fixed forward. Background: dark smoky dawn, warm gold out-of-focus highlights. Black, white, grey, gold, blood red only. No text. Correct anatomy and hands, blade one continuous piece attached to the hilt.
